purpose: Lock the local enclosure bearing, screw, nut, compression-stop and independent PCB-capture geometry so M1 remains electrical only even if one screw is one turn loose.

coordinate_system.origin: upper-left antenna-edge corner in the H6 PCB frame

compression_stop.route: owner-supplied final-assembly hardware; not a PCBA placement

screw.route: active distributor-stocked owner-supplied final-assembly hardware; not a PCBA placement

nut.route: active distributor-stocked owner-supplied final-assembly hardware; not a PCBA placement

cell_ntc_gap_pad.route: owner-supplied final-assembly consumable fitted after PCBA and before cells

antenna_connector_fit.method: undeformed connector slot G minus finished PCB thickness at the antenna lands; independent full tolerance corners

sources.evidence: G is dimensioned +/-0.10 mm; ordering option 175 gives G=1.75 mm for nominal 1.60-mm PCB
same G=1.75+/-0.10-mm edge slot for ordering option 175
finished thickness >=1.0 mm has +/-10% tolerance; explicit 1.60-mm example spans 1.44..1.76 mm; tighter thickness is not a published standard option

release_gate.closure_condition: obtain factory confirmation of a finished PCB thickness range that fits the exact SMA slot with declared clearance, or documented GCT/factory acceptance of the full current tolerance range; re-evaluate this audit before production release
release_gate.unverified_assumption: elastic spreading or manual forming of the connector prongs is not credited as assembly clearance
release_gate.changes_authorized_here: none; PCB stack, exact MPNs and purchase/fabrication authorization remain unchanged

battery_thermal_contacts.electrical_boundary: the silicone pad is the only material touching the cell can; no NTC electrode or PCB copper may contact the cell
battery_thermal_contacts.assembly_gate: before installing cells, dry-fit one exact 5x5x3-mm pad through each open holder channel and reject any holder lot that pinches the pad or prevents light compression without cell rocking

pilot_shoulder.role: four shell pilots locate each PCB in shear independently of screw preload

front_head_recess.result: head remains below the exterior surface

rear_captive_nut_recess.retention: three printed 0.15-mm snap detents retain the nut and prevent rotation while remaining owner-serviceable

edge_capture.role: each shell retains its own PCB against separation; the four pilot shoulders carry in-plane shear

sequence: snap four 04M025045HN nuts into the rear-shell hex recesses
centre one TG-A3500-5-5-3.0 pad on each NTC0/NTC1 silkscreen bed through the open 1048P cell channel
seat the RF PCB on all four rear pilots and capture lips
place all four 007.02.611 stops on the mounting axes
mate M1 in a parallel fixture without using it to pull the boards together
seat the UI PCB on all four front pilots and capture lips
insert four 50M025045P020 screws and tighten in a diagonal pattern until every stop is seated
install the two cells only after enclosure assembly and confirm both thermal pads compress lightly without lifting or rocking a cell
assembly.torque_basis: conservative assembly setting below published generic M2.5 nylon-6/6 guidance; verify seating, not high preload
assembly.one_loose_screw_case: three screws still clamp the four-stop stack; four pilots and independent edge lips retain both boards, so M1 is not the shear or separation stop

open_before_production_release: H6-SMA-FINISHED-THICKNESS-FIT: exact -175 SMA slot and finished PCB thickness ranges overlap by 0.11 mm at their worst corners; supplier-supported fit must be confirmed before H6.0.9 release-candidate acceptance
locked_here: four local bearing floors and recess dimensions
four pilot shoulders and four capture segments per PCB
worst-case full-nut engagement and buried screw tip
one direct 5x5x3-mm insulating thermal contact from each cell to its own board-fitted NTC
still_h6_0_1: five relaxed microcoax service-loop corridors and clip positions
enclosure clearance around the cable corridors and antenna solder inspection windows
still_h6_0_6: complete shell STEP, fillets and material/process tolerances
assembled 3D collision audit including cable free shape
receipt_checks: measure screw below-head length inside 19.8..20.2 mm
measure received nut height inside 1.8..2.0 mm
measure all four stops and reject outside 10.9..11.1 mm
confirm both exact 5x5x3-mm thermal pads pass through the holder channels and lightly compress against their own cells
confirm four-board-gap seating and that no screw tip reaches the exterior
